title: TV producer's master tape lost on his death
summary: James Fox tells of TV producer's master tape lost on his death, about 1995; c. 2020s at Los Angeles, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the guy that gave it to Chuck Clark was a TV producer in Los Angeles

plain: A UFO investigator named James Fox tells of a video recording kept on a Beta SP master tape, a professional TV tape format, that a man named Chuck Clark got from a television producer in Los Angeles. Fox says that when the producer died, around 1995, the master tape was lost, so whatever it showed was gone with him.
